meta.description:
🇻🇳 Vietnam Series Final Episode | Day 15

வணக்கம், நான் பிரியா! 🙏😊
Welcome to Vietnam Series in our "Plan2Travel" channel🤩

15 நாள் Vietnam trip முடிந்து Chennaiக்கு return ✈️
Ho Chi Minh airport delay 😓 → Kuala Lumpur layover → Chennai landing

இந்த vlogல நான் share பண்ணது:

Vietnam full trip experience 💯
Most liked places & must visit spots 😍
Vietnam e-visa process (Indians) 🛂
Total budget breakdown 💸
Chennai → Vietnam cheap travel tips ✈️
Ho Chi Minh airport pros & cons ⚠️
Kuala Lumpur airport experience

❤️Special moment:
Vietnamல சந்தித்த Malaysian Tamil couple என்னை family மாதிரி treat பண்ணி food share பண்ணினாங்க 🙏

👉 Next series starts soon…Guess the place in India 🇮🇳

🔗 Vietnam E-Visa Official Website:
https://evisa.gov.vn/

👍 LIKE, HYPE, SUBSCRIBE, SHARE & COMMENT to my channel "Plan2Travel"
🛎️ Watch till the end - New vlogs every 3 days, don't miss it!
